info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Product Deployment Review-spec
info.description: The Product Deployment Review API facilitates the submission of product deployment reviews within the banking management system. This endpoint allows users to efficiently register feedback on product deployments, ensuring that quality assessments are both streamlined and effectively documented. Common users of this API include product managers, quality assurance teams, and compliance officers who require detailed insights into deployment outcomes. Leveraging this API promotes accountability and enhances the overall product lifecycle management.

post.summary: Submit a review for product deployment PROD-700045
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the specified product deployment. Ensure to include all required information in your review to assist in the assessment of the deployment's quality and performance.

requestBody.description: Submit a new review for the product identified by the deployment ID 'PROD-700045'. This request allows users to provide their feedback, rating, and additional comments regarding their experience. Ensure that all required fields are filled out to successfully create the review.
